questions.q: Which texture has several performers playing different versions of the same melody at once?
questions.why: That is heterophony, found in silk and bamboo and Arab takht music.

questions.q: In sonata form, in which key does the second subject return in the recapitulation?
questions.why: In the recapitulation both subjects are in the tonic.

questions.q: Which structure is a minuet and trio?
questions.why: Minuet and trio is ternary: minuet, trio, minuet.

questions.q: Describe ritornello form in a Baroque concerto.
questions.model: A main theme (the ritornello) is played by the whole orchestra and returns in different keys, with soloists playing contrasting episodes between returns.
